features: Flexible Designer: shared rendering-rules module (flexible-render-rules.js) unifies Designer-canvas and live-page sub-element style/position computation for heading/paragraph/button — one source of truth instead of two hand-maintained copies

Flexible Designer: "Repeat per section" background option for Multi/Dynamic free-canvas sections — tile the background image once per 100vh section instead of stretching one image across the whole multi-section design
bugfixes: Flexible Designer: z-index now honored for text/card block sub-elements stacked over Volt/image blocks in free-canvas mode (previously always painted behind regardless of layer order)
Flexible Designer: canvas font now matches the live page's actual webfont
Volt Studio: closing the embedded Volt editor (✕ or backdrop) now warns before discarding unsaved edits instead of discarding silently
Flexible Designer: button sub-elements now match the live page's box model (display/alignment/font size) in free-canvas mode

Flexible Designer + live render: Multi/Dynamic section and background-plate height are now consistently computed from the authored per-band height × screen count in both the Designer canvas and the live page (previously viewport-dependent in the Designer and missing the multiplier entirely on the live page)
Admin: a stale unsaved Flexible Designer draft no longer silently overrides newer saved section data — now prompts to resume or discard
Media Library: Select Media picker no longer lists every already-registered file twice
